title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer during cross-regional backend flaps
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: In production we observed the SLO enforcer thrashing during short-lived cross-region backend flaps. Symptoms: rapid open/close of circuit breakers, aggressive load-shedding and repeated regional failovers which caused elevated error budgets and customer impact. Root cause: a race/ordering issue in the region health snapshot cache combined with overly aggressive immediate failover logic and no smoothing window on backoff ramp decisions. This PR implements a hotfix to prevent immediate oscillation during transient failures. Changes: (1) add timestamped region health snapshots and an atomic compare-and-swap update to avoid applying stale health states; (2) introduce a configurable smoothing window and exponential backoff cap for the enforcer so that transient spikes do not trigger full failover; (3) prefer short-lived sticky routing to an existing healthy region for a configurable grace period before initiating cross-region failover; (4) add dedicated integration test that simulates cross-region 503 flaps and validates no thrash; (5) expose a new metric slo_enforcer_backoff_smoothing_active and a trace span for enforcer-decision so we can monitor effectiveness. Tests & CI: unit tests added for health cache and backoff math, integration test added (regional-failover-regression). CI: unit / lint / e2e / integration passed after rerun. Deployment & rollout: marked as hotfix; canary rollout to 10% for 15 minutes then 100% if no regressions, with immediate rollback on increased error budget. Linear reference: ENG-2195. Backports: none required. Notes: this is narrowly-scoped to enforcer decision logic and observability; it avoids touching downstream routing code and keeps behavior backwards compatible by making smoothing params configurable and defaulting to conservative values.

review_comments: Ben Thompson: Can you add a short comment explaining the choice of default smoothing window? Concern is default values affecting tight-latency customers.
Asha Patel: Added explanatory comment and kept default conservative (100ms window, 2s max backoff). We also expose these as config so enterprise customers can tune.
Marta Ruiz: Unit tests look good; integration test reproduces the prior thrash locally. Suggest we add a metric tag for region so we can measure per-region smoothing activity.
Asha Patel: Added region tag to the metric and an additional assertion in the integration test to ensure tags are present.
Liam O'Connor: Approving — verified canary run on staging (10%) showed stable SLOs over 30m. CI green.

Rollout: canary -> full deploy; configurable params for enterprise tuning.
